title: LeadPages Help Centre
intro: Find the job, follow the steps, and jump straight to the control. Every app is covered — and a human can take it from here if you want it done for you.

topics.title: Make an edit go live
topics.summary: What you type in Manage is a draft. Visitors only see it after Publish.
topics.answer: Edit the page, check Live Preview, then press Publish.
steps: Change the text or photo in **Page editor**.
Open **Live Preview** and check phone width.
Press **Publish**. Until you do, the public site stays on the last published version.

topics.title: Add a section to the page
topics.summary: Marketplace turns an app on. Page editor is where you write it.
topics.answer: Turn the app on, fill in the card, preview, publish.
steps: Open **App Marketplace** and tap the app tile so it is on.
Open **Page editor** and use the section chip, or press **Need help?** on the card.
Fill headings, images, and the **Show on page** switch.
Preview, then **Publish**.

topics.title: Change the photos
topics.summary: Upload once, reuse from the library, then publish.
topics.answer: Use the image control on the section, or open Image library.
steps: Open the section in **Page editor**.
Use the image field to upload or pick from the library.
Open **Image library** if you need a photo you uploaded earlier.
**Publish** so the live site swaps the picture.

topics.title: Change colours and type
topics.summary: Appearance sets the whole site. A section can override it.
topics.answer: Site-wide colours live in Appearance. One section can look different with Custom section style.
steps: Open **Appearance** and set brand colours.
For one block only, open that app in Page editor and expand **Custom section style**.
Preview on a phone.
**Publish**.

topics.title: Change the menu
topics.summary: Navigation Menu controls labels, order, and submenus.
topics.answer: Edit Navigation Menu in Page editor, including what shows on phones.
steps: Open **Page editor → Navigation Menu**.
Rename links, reorder them, or nest a submenu.
Check the phone preview — the menu becomes a drawer.
**Publish**.

topics.title: Let customers price a job
topics.summary: Quote Builder is the full pricer. The quote section is the short form on the page.
topics.answer: Use Quote Builder for packages and options. Use the quote app if you only need a contact form.
steps: Open **Quote Builder** for packages, options, and the live quote page.
Or enable **Online Quote** / **Quote form** in Marketplace for a section on the homepage.
Send yourself a test.
**Publish** the site so the public form matches.

topics.title: Take a booking
topics.summary: Bookings is the diary. The page section is how visitors reach it.
topics.answer: Set up services in Bookings, then turn on the Bookings page section.
steps: Open **Bookings** and add what people can book.
Turn on the **Bookings** section in Marketplace if you want it on the page.
Open the public book link and book a test slot.
**Publish** if you changed the page section.

topics.title: Take an order
topics.summary: Orders is the shop desk. The storefront section is the public shelf.
topics.answer: Add products in Orders, then show the order section on the page.
steps: Open **Orders** and add a product with a price.
Turn on **Orders** in Marketplace so the page can show it.
Place a test order.
**Publish** after page changes.

topics.title: The live site didn't change
topics.summary: The usual cause: the edit is saved as a draft and has not been published.
topics.answer: Press Publish. Manage keeps a draft so a half-finished edit never hits the public site by accident.
steps: Look at **Live Preview**. If the new content is there, the draft is fine.
Press **Publish** and wait until it confirms.
Open the public site in a private window.
If Preview is also old, you may be on a different site in the switcher.

choices.when: Preview shows the new text, the public site does not
choices.do: Publish. Preview reads the draft. The public site reads the last publish.

choices.when: I restored a backup and nothing moved
choices.do: A restore loads that moment into the draft. Publish if you want visitors to see it.

choices.when: Another tab or a teammate edited too
choices.do: Publish offers to keep both sets of changes. Read the prompt before confirming.

topics.title: A section is missing
topics.summary: It is off in Marketplace, hidden on this device, or not published.
topics.answer: Turn the app on, check Show on page and device switches, then publish.
steps: App Marketplace: the tile should be on.
Page editor: **Show on page** is ticked.
Devices: **Show on phones** / **tablets** match how you are looking.
Publish.

choices.when: I cannot find the editor card
choices.do: The app is off. Turn the tile on in Marketplace, then come back to Page editor.

choices.when: I see it on desktop and not on my phone
choices.do: The device row on the card can hide a section on phones or tablets.
Some apps stay off until the subscription is active.

topics.title: A photo disappeared or looks wrong
topics.summary: The picture file is kept. The page just needs the link again.
topics.answer: Re-pick the photo from Image library. Restoring a backup does not delete the file.
steps: Open **Image library** and confirm the photo is still there.
On the section, choose that photo again.
If the crop looks tight, re-upload a wider original.
Publish.

choices.when: The library still has the photo
choices.do: Select it on the section. The page stores a link, not a separate copy.
Restore puts old links back. Re-pick anything that pointed at a photo you replaced later.

topics.title: It looks wrong on a phone
topics.summary: Check device visibility, the phone preview, and menu drawer.
topics.answer: Use Live Preview at phone width. A section can be hidden on phones on purpose.
steps: Open **Live Preview** and narrow it to a phone.
On the section card, confirm **Show on phones** is on.
For the menu, edit **Navigation Menu** and check the drawer.
Publish after you are happy.

choices.when: A whole block is gone on the phone only
choices.do: Untick was used on Show on phones. Turn it back on.
Phone menus open as a drawer. Edit labels in Navigation Menu.

topics.title: A paid app will not turn on
topics.summary: Orders, Bookings, and Quote Builder need an active add-on.
topics.answer: Open Billing, confirm the add-on, then enable the app again.
steps: Open **Billing** from site tools.
Confirm the add-on is active.
Return to Marketplace and turn the app on.
If you want us to set it up, request paid help.

topics.title: I edited the wrong site
topics.summary: The site switcher decides which business you are changing.
topics.answer: Check the site name in the header before you publish.
steps: Read the site name next to the tools.
Switch to the right business.
If you already published the wrong one, edit it back or restore a backup on that site.
Then publish the correct site.

choices.when: I published to the wrong business
choices.do: Open that site, restore the backup from before the publish, and publish again.

topics.title: Finding your way around

Press **Publish** when you are ready for the live website to update.

topics.title: Page editor

Preview on phone width, then **Publish**.

Image URLs live in your config — the files themselves are stored in Cloudinary.

topics.title: App Marketplace

Tap a tile to enable or disable that app.
Edit the content in **Page editor**.
Paid apps may ask you to subscribe before they go live.

topics.title: Publish & Live Preview
topics.summary: Draft edits vs what the public sees — and how to go live safely.
steps: Edit freely — autosave keeps your draft.
Open **Live Preview** (side-by-side on wide screens).
Press **Publish**. A backup is saved automatically first.
Use **View live site** to confirm on the real URL.

topics.title: Backups & restore
topics.summary: Restore points for design and copy. Images are URLs — not file archives.
steps: Open **Backups** from Site tools or the Dashboard card.
Save a named backup before big changes.
Restore replaces the current design with that snapshot (a “Before restore” safety copy is saved first).
Download JSON if you want an offline copy.
tips: Restoring does not recreate deleted Cloudinary image files — only the URLs in config.
Use the newest “Before restore” backup if a restore went wrong.

topics.title: Images & Image library
topics.summary: Upload, replace, and reuse photos. Clearing an image can remove the Cloudinary file.
steps: In any image field, press **Upload** or pick from the **Image library**.
Prefer landscape ~1920×1080 for heroes; keep file size reasonable.
Replace an image to update that slot; Clear removes it from the section.
Publish after image changes.

Images and content stay until someone deletes the site — unpaid sites are for manual review.

topics.title: Need a human? Paid help

steps: Search this Help Centre for the app or task first.
If you are stuck, press **Request paid help**.
Describe what you need, which site, and any deadline.
We (or your assigned partner) reply in **Support** messages and quote the work if needed.

topics.title: Hero Banner
topics.summary: First impression above the fold
topics.body: Every trade site lives or dies on the first screen. LeadPages heroes pair a bold headline with highlighted urgency text, supporting sub-copy and icon badges — built for local service searches on mobile.
features: **Highlight text support** — Colour a key phrase like "We'll clear it today" so it pops against the headline.
**Trust badge row** — Up to four icon badges (licensed, insured, same-day) sit directly under the copy.
**Mobile-first typography** — Headlines scale cleanly on phones where most emergency trade searches happen.
steps: Open **Page editor** (or App Marketplace) and find **Hero Banner**.
Turn the app **on** if it is off — locked mode lets you edit without accidentally disabling apps.
Edit the heading, copy, images and lists for that section.
Use **Live Preview** to check phone and desktop.
When happy, press **Publish** so visitors see the update.
